question: How does the simplest Einstein solution link black and white holes to two universes?
answer: The simplest Einstein solution links a black hole and a white hole to two universes. Edges on the map can't simply stop, so a white hole and a second universe appear to finish them. Tap each ? to extend the map until every edge ends at a singularity or infinity.
move: Even the simplest solution holds two universes.
